sources.verified_fact: Title page confirms proceedings version. Section 3 (p.15940) learns g(f_new(q)) approximately f_old(q), using paired document embeddings; inference queries the unchanged legacy ANN index. It specifies Orthogonal Procrustes, low-rank affine, and a residual MLP. Section 2.4 identifies adaptation as post-hoc rather than encoder training.

uses.reason: Supports the query-side adaptation branch of the jointly cited sentence: new-encoder queries are translated into the old index space. It does not establish the document-side conversion branch, which is separately attributed to embeddingconverter. Later claims about other alignment papers and ARC2 are outside this key's scope.
uses.evidence: Publisher PDF abstract and Section 3, pp.15938 and 15940.

uses.reason: The Drift-Adapter sentence correctly states new-model query to legacy-index translation and the three adapter families. Paired samples are document embeddings used to fit a query-time map; this is not conversion of stored old document vectors into the new space. The frozen-encoder/paired-embedding comparison is consistent with its post-hoc setup. ARC2-specific behavior and other cited methods are not validated by this source.
